global: Long-form explainer (walking toward a star at fixed speed: what path on Earth). Off-white canvas, black line art; red for routes, spirals, scribbles, star labels and correction text; grey for maps/globes and land; black night-sky scenes with white line art, white stars and grey constellation lines. Opening presenter-with-paper and whiteboard with a static question card; red series title card (animated mascot); then a sky time-lapse with three robed travellers, a coastal map with a red spiral route, a dark polar globe, presenter whiteboard conditions, Jerusalem-Bethlehem route sketches, desert and Africa maps, a seated-at-laptop planetarium scene, a black sky with labelled candidate objects scribbled out one by one, a Mars path chart, side-by-side map panels, a hovercraft, a red-scribbled globe and polar spiral, a decorated house, a night desert road with falling babies; red end card.

Two continuous animations: the sky time-lapse f355-554 (red-labelled SIRIUS arcs across and sets, the sun rises and arcs, Sirius rises again; travellers stay on the ground line; stars shimmer every frame, 30-55k px/frame) and the dark polar globe f792-900 (red spiral rings around the travellers accumulate; static camera, phase response 0.87-0.98). Series title card f307-354 animates every frame. 21 hard cuts plus hidden cuts f354|f355, f554|f555 and f900|f901.
